    The band relation in a module #

    For a band b and a finite-dimensional module M, the half-words at position p satisfy h⁺_R(p) = l_p^*(h⁺_R(p+1)) and h⁺_L(p+1) = (l_p⁻¹)^*(h⁺_L(p)). The band relation R (chains along one period) has full domain and range on the numerator at a position, so the splitting lemma applies.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.rightW_cons {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (b : CWord D.Q) (p : Fin b.n) :
    HWord.inf (b.rightW p) = HWord.cons (b.lt p) (HWord.inf (b.rightW (b.succ p)))
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.leftW_cons {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (b : CWord D.Q) (p : Fin b.n) :
    HWord.inf (b.leftW (b.succ p)) = HWord.cons (b.lt p).inv (HWord.inf (b.leftW p))
    source

                theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.exists_band_split {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : Alt S b) (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k B M] [FiniteDimensional k M] (p : Fin b.n) :
